content.description: The entire text of the log entry.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the log entry was reported. Logged using {@link DateTime#millis} format.

startLineNum.description:
The line number (1-based) of the log header if read from a file.

@see #endLineNum

node.description: Id of C3 node (e.g. task, data...) that log entry was logged from.

process.description: Id of process that log entry was logged from.

thread.description: Id of thread that log entry was logged from.

cluster.description: Id of {@link Cluster} that log entry was logged from.

env.description: Id of {@link Env} that log entry was logged from.

app.description: Id of {@link App} that log entry was logged from.

user.description: Id of {@link User} that logged the entry.

typeName.description: Name of the type that log entry was logged from.

actionName.description: Name of the action that log entry was logged from.

actionParent.description: Id of the parent action for the current action.

actionRoot.description: Id of the root action for the current action.

asyncParent.description: Id of async action call (i.e. the one to submit to queue). Optional - only use if running as part of async action.

asyncRoot.description: Id of root async action call. Optional - only use if running as part of async action.

asyncDepth.description: Depth of async action call. Optional - only use if running as part of async action.

job.description:
Id of the current job. Generally, the job is triggered by an async action. {@link #async} records the
id of the action submitting the job to the queue, whereas this records the id of the job itself.
Optional - only use if running as part of job.

jobParent.description: Id of the parent job. Optional - only use if running as part of job.

jobRoot.description: Id of the root job. Optional - only use if running as part of job.

parentActionIds.description: String representing the ids of the parent actions separated by colon. Optional - null if the action is root action

actionFunc.description: Unique identifier of the TypeName#ActionName call.

parentActionFuncs.description: String representing the {@link #actionFunc} of the parent actions separated by colon. Optional - null if the action is root action

fetchFilter.description: The fetch filter that was used to fetch the data

fetchInclude.description: The fetch include that was used to fetch the data

title:
Represents a single timestamped log entry in a C3 log, produced by {@link Logger} for an action.

@see Log.Profile
name: Log.Entry
